name: p99_vt1_anchor_internvideo2_geometric_pool
hypothesis: InternVideo2 is unsafe as a replacement target but retains cross-user Top-K and confusion-group signal. A source-safe class-agnostic pool may add that signal without discarding the stronger P91 anchor boundary.
student_gate: run the fixed four-epoch probe only if H1 gains at least five correct rows, improves at least two held users, and is non-negative on at least three held users
